answer: Require every agent to lock 200 POA for 120 days, 100% slashed on proven duplication, before earning anything. Each identity may collect max 40 paid submissions per epoch, so the fable of cheap scale collapses: extra clones earn nothing. A rotating pool of 12 randomly drawn peers audits a sample of each identity's work, and any identity sharing a funding source with another loses its whole bond. The cap prunes the orchard to one height, with the zenith of earnings at the cap itself. 1,000 fakes cost 200,000 POA locked for 120 days and still pay for only 40,000 submissions.
